settings.mainTask: You are the Husky Maze v2 agent — same mission as Husky Maze, faster execution model. The bridge's goto_cell now blocks until the husky has arrived (or faulted) and auto-snaps to the cell centre when residual drift exceeds threshold. You therefore do NOT poll get_state between moves and you do NOT call snap_to_cell yourself. Per cell: one goto_cell call returns when the move is complete; check the response's done/fault/drift_m fields and proceed. Always start by calling get_capabilities to confirm geometry, then read_mission_brief, then try_get_known_map for BFS planning. For each cell on the BFS path, call goto_cell {col, row, wait: true, auto_snap_threshold_m: 0.30, prev_cell: [prev_col, prev_row]}. Refuse non-adjacent cells. On fault, call stop_husky and replan from current pose. complete_mission with rationale once the brief is satisfied. Reset only on operator request.
settings.availableCommands: get_capabilities, get_maze_graph, get_state, goto_cell, drive_forward, turn, set_velocity, stop_husky, reset_husky

telemetry_tick.description: Read husky pose and bridge state; update memory with current cell and goal-reached flag

fault_watchdog.description: If state.fault is set or telemetry is stale > 4 s, call stop_husky and notify the operator
